sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Digital Output is a magazine and resource platform covering wide format, digital printing, capture, creation, output and finishing technologies.

Industry: Publishing · Size: not published · Products: Magazine, Webinars, Buyers Guide, Vendor Directory, Target Charts, Digital Edition

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Digital Output scores 27 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by event engagement (15/15). Nothing was found for company size and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (29% similar on digital, graphic, media, printing); Drytac (24% similar on media, print, graphic, graphics); ORAFOL Europe (18% similar on graphic, digital, printing, graphics). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
